Dear Masa-sama.

Hello, my name is Crynaut, and I am currently preparing to become a Vtuber.
I have been a fan of Masa-sama's illustrations for a long time, so I decided to apply for your illustrations since I saw that you were accepting requests.

Nice to meet you, Dr. Shabi! My name is "Uru" (@_noopy_5151) and I am a vtuber guesser!
I saw your illustrations on X and was attracted by your clear and beautiful illustrations! I would love to commission you to draw for me. The person I would like you to draw is VTuber "Yura Kagura". I like the atmosphere of the girl waiting under the cold winter night and the girl saying good morning in the morning. I also like Ms. Yabi's worldview, so I'm fine with leaving it up to her to decide on the outfit, seasonal feel, etc! I would also like to ask for your permission to use the image on YouTube, X, etc. I would also appreciate it if you could separate the layers of the character and the message you would like to receive from me.

Yura Kagura
X:@Kagura_uraY
There is no 3-sided drawing.
She is a bink colored white fox girl.
Please check my X profile page for more information.

https://x.com/Kagura_uraY

Please give me an illustration of a fox bride

Expression She is smiling happily or happily with a shy smile before the wedding.
(Not limited to the above, as long as it looks happy and kind.)

Characteristics: Kemomi (fox ears)
(You can choose "no kemomi" if you like. In that case, please read the notes at the bottom)

Hair style is up to the author.
Hair color is up to you. White fox is also acceptable.

Clothes: White kimono
White or white with a slight yellowish tinge (other colors can be mixed lightly)

Please don't use any of the following (accessories and ornaments are acceptable)
Cotton hat (headwear): None (because it hides chemo mimi)
Possession of red Japanese umbrella: Not allowed (Because it stands out more than the person)
Wearing a mask of a fox None (Because it hides the face. Possession is allowed)

Other ornaments and accessories are up to you.
I'm happy if it's bright and gorgeous.

Season Autumn for harvest (ginkgo, maple) or spring for budding (sakura)
Weather: Rainy or sunny after rain
(Seasons and weather are for reference only. Please draw freely without worrying about them.)

Composition and resolution are up to you.
As an illustration for the exhibition, please draw one character, full body (above the knee or above the waist is fine. I'll leave it up to you.)
I would like to make a large size illustration, no commercial use, no layers, plus drawing (if possible).
I would like to ask for this amount with high expectations.

No address, please.

Reference materials
https://twitter.com/pinsuke_m/status/1459135013924978694

Purpose of use
In accordance with Skeb rules, use for fox-related promotion (publicity, local festivals, etc., limited to non-commercial use)

We support the Inaho Festival (Kitsune no Yomeiri) in Yamaguchi Prefecture.

I hope you enjoy drawing it!
Please consider!

Exceptions
If you don't have Kemomi
I will treat her as a normal person.
For the fox bride setting, please have her wear a white kimono and a "white fox mask".
(Fox masks and cat masks are similar, so please be careful)
